fusions.name: Joint by Joint
fusions.desc: A practised cut to the joint that deals 26 damage, always lands as a critical hit and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 8 seconds. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: First Taste
fusions.desc: Flicks a skewer that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 12% of the damage dealt. Against an enemy that has not been wounded yet, it has 30% more critical chance.

fusions.name: Exact Serving
fusions.desc: Restores 16 health to you, with a 25% chance to land as a critical heal.
When you land a critical hit, you heal for 20% of all damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
fusions.name: Seasoned Hand
